snippet.title: Follow My Steps  - Official Game Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Follow My Steps is a narrative open world RPG blending exploration, stealth, magical combat, and impactful moral choices. Full english voice over will be availabe in the final release.
🎮 Wishlisht now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487300/Follow_My_Steps/

Also coming to consoles and looking for a publisher! 
Gamers ping them!

Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/seed.midnight
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/MidnightGamesOfficial/
Tiktok : https://www.tiktok.com/@seed.midnight
Twitter :  https://x.com/MidnightGamesFR


Play as Sova, protect and raise Lou, your wolf pup. Together, forge a unique bond that will shape your journey and lead to one of its many endings.
Sova is neither a chosen one nor a warrior. She is a mother. And her world is falling apart.
When faced with the unknown, you’ll need to learn how to survive, guide, love… and sometimes sacrifice. Lou watches everything, and each choice will leave a mark on him.
The open world waiting for you won’t let you rest. Creatures prowl, ruins whisper forgotten truths, and the shadow of the Midnight Pack grows. You’ll have to run, fight, or hide. The choice is yours.
Will you follow your heart, your instincts… or your emotions? Will you protect Lou from danger or teach him how to face it?
